_comment: Row id -> Xray Test issue key for the GENERATED negative dataset. pim-search-negative-dataset.csv is regenerated by globalSetup and gitignored, so keys typed into it would be wiped every run — they live here instead and are merged in by generate-negative-facet-dataset.ts. Row ids are stable, so this map only changes when a facet row is added or removed. Leave a value blank (or omit the key) and the reporter lists that test as unmapped rather than guessing.
